scoring_protocol._does_not_move_the_batteries: Top-K changes structural scoring and evaluation, not prompt content. family_content_id 1e3445f1b6769169287f6d091e50086e3cf9b66398d1138af8f137b31e74cd58 stands.
scoring_protocol.critical_tokens: critical tags identify prediction POSITIONS, not vocabulary entries, so those positions use this same KL and need no separate support rule
scoring_protocol.k_is_not_outcome_selected: maintainer-selected 2026-10-04. No sweep was run and K must not be tuned against D1/D2/D3 results.
scoring_protocol.reference_for_depth: the intact current parent; the candidate is that parent with the candidate block bypassed. NOT the original teacher -- DEPTH's objective is local and parent-relative, and forcing the teacher's support onto it would score a different question
scoring_protocol.reverse_kl_partition: the SAME reference-defined K+1 partition as the forward direction. One state evaluation must not carry two incompatible partitions
scoring_protocol.support: the Top-200 entries of the REFERENCE distribution at each prediction position
scoring_protocol.tail: every vocabulary entry outside that support, aggregated into one K+1 bucket
